title: hydrangea macrophylla var. otaksa
intro: Hydrangea macrophylla var. otaksa, commonly known as the Otaksa Bigleaf Hydrangea, is a variety of flowering plant in the Hydrangea genus. It is native to Japan and is valued for its medicinal properties. The leaves and flowers of the Otaksa Bigleaf Hydrangea have been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to their reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties.
